import pathlib,json,hashlib,subprocess,re
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
root=pathlib.Path.cwd();run=root/'reports/runs/recovery_r18_sdk_client_fix1_20261016';m=json.loads((run/'artifact_manifest.json').read_bytes());old=root/'reports/tasks/R18-sdk-client-fix1.md';new=root/'reports/tasks/R18-sdk-client-fix1-material-repair.md';assert not new.exists()
for e in m['files']:assert hashlib.sha256((root/e['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==e['sha256'],e['path']
blob=subprocess.run(['git','show','c5d1e734510afdc2d9754a1b9938dfd612796e3b:reports/tasks/R18-sdk-client-fix1.md'],cwd=root,capture_output=True,check=True,timeout=30).stdout
candidates=[blob,blob.replace(b'\n',b'\r\n')];matching=[value for value in candidates if hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()==m['report_sha256']];assert len(matching)==1;expected=matching[0]
now=datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(timespec='seconds');text=old.read_text(encoding='utf-8');text=text.replace('# R18 · SDK/CLI 定向修复 1','# R18 · SDK/CLI 定向修复 1 · 材料修订',1)
text=re.sub(r'^文档首次创建时间：.*$','文档首次创建时间：'+now,text,count=1,flags=re.M);text=re.sub(r'^本次写作开始/结束：.*$','本次写作开始/结束：'+now+' / '+now,text,count=1,flags=re.M);text=re.sub(r'^最后更新时间/证据截止：.*$','最后更新时间/证据截止：'+now,text,count=1,flags=re.M)
text+='\n## 10. 新文件边界与旧报告恢复\n\n'+now+' · 此文件为新的独立材料修订，保留原230测试和两Must完整事实及全部材料失败。旧R18-sdk-client-fix1.md按原manifest绑定raw SHA f3d196caaeffe2d76ef443e3c033e2bb01401f25a8c43442b0c95abb2c82d6f9恢复；先比较Git LF候选不匹配exit1且没有mutation，再在两个候选中只选cryptographic完全匹配的CRLF原bytes，不假定Git文本等于原raw。原110封存成员及旧helper保持不变，现修订/后置proof/新增manifest用新文件名。未修改正式SDKsource6d/根属性/原169材料/金标。原artifact_manifest_final.json为早期未提交候选已superseded，其旧报告hash不作为最终结论；最终范围将由新artifact_manifest_material_repair.json明确列原110 digest和新成员。\n'
new.write_text(text,encoding='utf-8');assert new.read_text(encoding='utf-8')==text
old.write_bytes(expected);assert hashlib.sha256(old.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==m['report_sha256']
for e in m['files']:assert hashlib.sha256((root/e['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==e['sha256']
print(json.dumps({'new_report':str(new),'new_report_sha256':hashlib.sha256(new.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'old_report_exact_raw_restored':True,'all_original110_raw_unchanged':True,'source_sha':'6d85742b0114cc5e304e88b2aa930755ccce9bc9','commit':'not_run'}))
